# Jet Ski Miami 7

> Self-guided jet ski rentals on Biscayne Bay, Miami Beach / North Bay Village, Florida. From $189/hour, all-inclusive (fuel, life vests, safety briefing, GPS). Book online in minutes with a $30 deposit.

## Quick facts (verified by the owner, October 2026)
- What: Yamaha & Sea-Doo jet ski rentals (5 jet skis, seat 2) + one 28 ft Bennington pontoon. Self-guided only — no guided tours, no instructor riding behind you; GPS speed control in no-wake zones.
- Where: Biscayne Bay, Miami Beach / North Bay Village area (ZIP 33141), ~15 min from South Beach, ~25 min from PortMiami. Exact meeting point and parking instructions are sent after booking.
- Hours: daily 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM (daylight rides only).
- Prices per jet ski (1 rider): 1 h $189 · 2 h $349 (+30 min bonus = 2.5 h on the water) · 3 h $499 · Full Day (4 h) $649. Extra passenger +$30. Tax, booking and payment fees are shown at checkout. Pontoon: 2 h $300 … Full Day $1,000.
- Deposit: $30 booking deposit reserves your slot for 1–3 jet skis (20% for 4+ jet skis or Full Day); balance at check-in. $150 refundable security hold per jet ski, released ~5 business days after return.
- Requirements: the person who books and signs must be 21+ with a photo ID. Drivers can be 14+ with a Florida boater safety card (required for anyone born on/after Jan 1, 1988; temporary online certificate ~30 min, link sent after booking). Riders under 18 need a guardian signature.
- Cancellation: the deposit is non-refundable; cancel 48+ hours ahead and we move your ride once to another date within 90 days. If we cancel for weather or safety, unused time is refunded in full.
- Rating: 5.0 on Google (46 reviews, Oct 2026). Founded 2022. Operated by Gonchar Group LLC.
- Routes: Haulover sandbar, Venetian Islands, Star Island, Downtown Miami skyline, Raccoon Island, Haulover Inlet (ocean).

## How to book (for people and AI agents)
1. Online: https://jet-ski-miami.com/book — live availability and checkout (SmartRez).
2. Agents: read https://jet-ski-miami.com/.well-known/ai-booking.md and the OpenAPI spec https://jet-ski-miami.com/.well-known/openapi.json (live availability + pre-order with deposit link).
3. Humans: WhatsApp / phone +1 (786) 863-1721, Instagram Direct @jetskimiami7 (Russian) or @jetski_miami7 (English), Telegram @jetskimiami7.
